name: An Orphan Looking For a Home

meta.wiki: An Orphan Looking For a Home

summary: Kindal Moonweaver has news for you after Darnassus: the nest was saved, but its mother died. The eggs will soon hatch, and Kindal offers you one to care for. Quentin waits by the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Nest Without a Mother
sections.body: Kindal Moonweaver greets you after your return from Darnassus. The nest was saved, but its mother died before help could reach her. The eggs are close to hatching, and they need a good keeper. Kindal offers you one as a pet. Carry the egg to Quentin at the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats if you want to care for it. Quentin can tell you more.

sections.title: Quentin at the Flats
sections.body: Quentin waits in Thousand Needles, though the races are not why he is there. He studies whether new, fertile soil can restore the land. He hopes to find a water source nearby. The change from Feralas to Thousand Needles seems strange to him. Quentin says strange magic was at work when it happened.

sections.title: What Quentin Makes of the Egg
sections.body: Quentin identifies the egg as a sprite darter egg, nearly mature and in remarkably good condition. He is amazed you found one. Sprite darters are rarely seen in Feralas these days, and Quentin has heard that poachers hunt them to capture or kill them for various reasons. He thinks that is a shame. Grown sprite darters are beautiful. How did you come across such a find?

faq.q: Where did the egg come from?
aliases: where did the egg come from
faq.answer: While you were in Darnassus, Kindal Moonweaver and others saved a nest full of eggs. The mother died before they could reach her.
At the race tracks in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why is Quentin at the Shimmering Flats?
aliases: why is quentin at the raceway
faq.answer: Quentin studies whether new, fertile soil can restore the land and hopes to find a nearby water source. He is not there for the races.
